_about: Versions, channels and images that no installed artifact carries (IBM docs, vendor matrices, chosen defaults). Read through src/helpers/version_catalog.py (shell: vr_catalog in version_resolver.sh). Paths are '/'-separated. Edit values here; legacy_version_resolution.py keeps the values these replaced, used only when this file or a key is unreadable.

rhoai_channel_by_release._source: IBM docs, prep-cluster-openshift-ai: Software Hub 5.3.x / 5.4.0 pin Red Hat OpenShift AI 2.25. Releases not listed use the catalog's default channel.

helm._source: The Helm this repo pins (Concert runner, Mission Control, mirroring). DataStax supports Mission Control with Helm 3.14.0 - 3.18.x only.

concert._source: IBM's version matrix pairs Hub 3.0.3 (Concert 3.1.0) with Turbonomic 8.21.2.
